name: Fiana
source:
The Princess of Gaihalt.
She is stubborn, has to get her way and your typical princess.
She learns of Hadele’s evil aspirations at the Millennium Festival and unable to sit by and watch the weak-willed King do nothing, she organizes a search for the orbs herself.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071028072305/http://www.hirameki-int.com/apdvd/products/dragonia/pop_cha04.html]official site[/url]]
